died.name: Jean-François de La Harpe
died.desc: French playwright, writer and literary critic
died.cause: his final recorded words, spoken the day before his death
died.last_words: I am grateful to Divine Mercy for having left me sufficient recollection to feel how consoling these prayers are to the dying.

died.name: Johnny Frank Garrett
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
died.last_words: I'd like to thank my family for loving me and taking care of me, and the rest of the world can kiss my ass.

born.name: Bernard Le Bovier de Fontenelle
born.last_words: I do not suffer, my friends; I only feel a certain difficulty of living.

born.name: Thomas Edison
born.cause: speaking words of unclear meaning as he was dying

born.name: Moses Annenberg
born.cause: to his son, Walter Annenberg. Moses Annenberg had been released from prison a month earlier after being convicted of tax evasion
born.last_words: Walter, who knows what is the scheme of things? My suffering has all been for the purpose of making you a man.

born.name: Gene Vincent
born.desc: American rock and roll and rockabilly musician
born.cause: dying of a bleeding ulcer while in his mother's trailer
born.last_words: Mama, if I get through this, I swear I'll be a better man.

born.name: Hank Gathers
born.last_words: I don't want to lay down.
